title: 6-inch eggless cakes from $39.99 for Vineyard and Tallawong birthdays
summary:
Need a small custom cake for a weeknight birthday near Vineyard or Tallawong, and don't want to ask about eggs?

Riverstone makes every cake 100% eggless. Not some, every one. A 6-inch serves 6-8 and starts at $39.99. An 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99. Fifteen flavours, including Mango and Rasmalai.

That's not a smaller order. That's a deliberate one, which is why it still gets the same custom design and fresh-to-order sponge.

Order with 48 hours notice. Pickup from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking. Open from 6am on weekdays, so collection fits around the Tallawong train and the school run.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 with a photo reference.
